card.name: All-caps warnings before kidney terms
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS warning headings just before a kidney term such as RENAL or NEPHROTOXICITY. It fires on the word or word part right before it, such as IMPAIRED, SEVERE, AND, IS or OF.

modes.label: Before RENAL in headings
modes.description: Last part of a capitalized word or a linking word right before RENAL in a warning or dosage heading.
modes.example: DOSAGE GUIDELINES FOR PATIENTS WITH IMPAI<<RED>> RENAL FUNCTION Creatinine Clearance mL

modes.label: Before NEPHRO- terms
modes.description: Linking words in capitalized toxicity warnings that are followed by NEPHROTOXICITY or similar kidney words.

card.writes: It pushes up tokens starting with NE, as in NEPHRO, and pushes down tokens starting with N.
card.plain: It notices capitalized warning headings where a kidney word such as renal or nephrotoxicity is about to come next.
